build_Attend_module: build a torch.nn.Module that computes scaled dot-product attention with optional flash attention, causal masking, and dropout
create_flash_attention: create a flash attention path using torch scaled_dot_product_attention with configurable SDP backends and packed sequence support
test_selective_attention: test selective attention that prevents each token from being attended to by future tokens using a learned gate
refactor_sparse_topk_attention: refactor sparse top-k attention to keep only the top-k attention logits before softmax with optional straight-through estimator
review_Intermediates_dataclass: review the Intermediates dataclass that stores qk similarities, pre and post softmax attention, values, cached kv pairs, and log probs
